title: chore(deps): bump lucide-react from 1.29.0 to 1.31.0
body:
Bumps [lucide-react](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/HEAD/packages/lucide-react) from 1.29.0 to 1.31.0.
Release notes

Sourced from lucide-react's releases.

Version 1.31.0

What's Changed

  • feat(icons): added mail-badge icon by @​lazerg in lucide-icons/lucide#4638
  • feat(icons): add angle by @​samuelalake in lucide-icons/lucide#4545
  • feat(icons): added eject icon by @​ThibautMarechal in lucide-icons/lucide#4043

New Contributors

  • @​lazerg made their first contribution in lucide-icons/lucide#4638
  • @​ThibautMarechal made their first contribution in lucide-icons/lucide#4043

Full Changelog: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/compare/1.30.0...1.31.0

Version 1.30.0

What's Changed

  • chore(icons): refine & rename various emoji icons by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4606
  • fix(scripts): removed toBeRemovedInVersion from all scripts and tools by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4674
  • feat(icons): added audio-lines-x icon by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4590
  • feat(lab): added chinese-character icon to lab by @​congemcd in lucide-icons/lucide#4212
  • test(packages): updates unit test snapshots with face-slightly-smiling by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4676
  • ci(dev): fix post-release job by downloading lucide-font artifact by name by @​ericfennis with @​Copilot in lucide-icons/lucide#4675
  • feat(icons): add shield-lock icon by @​Caisere in lucide-icons/lucide#3508
  • ci(security): Pin sha actions by @​jguddas in lucide-icons/lucide#4678
  • feat(icons): added broom icon by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4683

New Contributors

  • @​congemcd made their first contribution in lucide-icons/lucide#4212
  • @​Caisere made their first contribution in lucide-icons/lucide#3508

Full Changelog: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/compare/1.29.0...1.30.0
